concerns.text: Task T000b (download or generate the raw dataset CSV) may invoke the synthetic generator defined in T007b on download failure, but T007b is listed *after* T000b. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; the synthetic generator must be defined before any task that could call it.

concerns.text: Task T020 (evaluation metrics) relies on the extended behavior introduced by T046 (no‑metrics‑on‑synthetic rule) which modifies `code/training/evaluate.py`. T046 is scheduled *after* T020, so T020 would execute without the intended safeguard. Reorder T046 to precede T020.
